<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Derive every score from the audit's facts with the rubric and write audit.json: the facts as recorded, the scores, and the scorecard's rows with what each value means. The same facts always give the same bytes.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower audit score [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir string` | `audit` | the audit folder (paper.yaml, targets.yaml, consistency.yaml) |
